en: Colorized vintage street-view postcard showing a wide road lined with one- and two‑story buildings with arcades and cafes, tables and chairs placed along the sidewalks. People walk and stand in the street, with low mountains visible in the background. Greek text appears at the top of the image and on shop signs. A Greek postage stamp with cancellation marks is printed or affixed in the upper center. The lower right bears the watermark of the website elia.org.gr.
